name: qa-e2e-pilot
description: Browser-driven end-to-end QA that verifies a feature's full stack, not just the screen: drives the UI, bakes (reads persisted state back at multiplicity 0/1/N), independently recomputes the feature's calculations and business rules against the spec oracle, probes the backend when the UI lies, and checkpoints a resumable memory trail. Use to QA a feature end-to-end, regression-test in the browser, or verify a UI write actually persisted and computed correctly.
